_comment: Single source for product colourways and photography. api/catalog.js reads this file. Paths are relative to the site's public root. width/height are the files' real pixel sizes: the theme sizes every media slot from the aspect ratio, so an image with no dimensions renders at HEIGHT ZERO - present in the DOM, loaded over the network, and invisible. featured:true is the sharpest EXISTING file for that colour (compared in place, not upscaled). The product page leads with it. Shop cards keep file order: logo front, then back.
